CBUS.stands_in_for: the input capacitance at the low end of its tolerance and retaining only the declared fraction of that under bias, which is the case that rings highest

CDAMP.stands_in_for: the damper's capacitance on the same basis

LCABLE.stands_in_for: the cable and the connector as one inductance, a declared budget rather than a measurement

RDAMP.stands_in_for: the damper's resistance at the high end of its tolerance

RDETECT.stands_in_for: everything the detector draws from the input, as one resistance; the switch is open at this instant so the charger is not connected

SOURCE.stands_in_for: the source as an ideal step to the top of the Type-C range, which is the largest step a compliant source can present

description: a live source connected through a cable's inductance to the board's input capacitance, with the damper the design carries
name: hot_plug_ring_at_the_input_receptacle
